t: The Wireless Router can connect two separate Controller networks together.$(br2)Place an antenna on top of the router. The tier of that antenna determines the wireless range.
无线路由器可连接两个独立的控制器网络。$(br2)在路由器顶部放置一根天线，其等级将决定无线作用范围。
Wireless routers work with routing networks. Use routing cables and connectors on the local side, then publish or consume channels through the router GUI.
无线路由器需配合路由网络使用。本地端请使用路由网络线缆与路由连接器，再通过路由器GUI发布或订阅频道。
